arabic text: Paani kabhi piya nahi, thanda Rabab ne
english translation text: Rabab never again drank cold water.

arabic text: Pehlu me saath saath rakha apni qabr tak\nAsgher tera jala huwa jhoola Rabab ne
english translation text: She kept Asghar's burned cradle beside her\nuntil her own grave, O Rabab.

arabic text: Asgher samajh ke godh me apni utha liya\nDekha jo khelta koi bacha Rabab ne
english translation text: Whenever she saw a child playing,\nshe lifted him into her lap, thinking him Asghar.

arabic text: Bethi rahi hai dhoop me who baade Karbala\nSar per rakha nahi koi Saaya Rabab ne
english translation text: After Karbala, she continued to sit beneath the sun;\nRabab never placed any shade above her head.

arabic text: Karbobala ke dasht me neze ki nok per\nApne pisar ka dekha hai lasha Rabab ne
english translation text: In the desert of Karbala, upon the point of a spear,\nRabab saw the body of her son.

arabic text: Mayyit lahoo bhari huwi bête ki dekh kar\nBan me kiya hai shukr ka sajda Rabab ne
english translation text: Seeing her son's body soaked in blood,\nRabab prostrated in gratitude in the wilderness.

arabic text: Asgher na dekh le kahin neze se nange sar\nBaalon se yoon chupa liya chehra Rabab ne
english translation text: Lest Asghar see her bareheaded from the spear,\nRabab hid her face behind her hair.

arabic text: Zahra ke saamne hai 'Takallum' woh surkhroo\nZainab se pehle khaya hai durra Rabaab ne
english translation text: O "Taqallum", she stands honoured before Zahra;\nbefore Zainab, Rabab herself received the lashes.
